intro: A torn delivery manifest found on a restocked freight container directs couriers to a regional merchant hub in the Barrens. Durotar Supply and Logistics relies on traveling wanderers to recover lost crates and return paperwork to their post west of the Crossroads. Completing the return maintains essential supply chains and trade commerce across central Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"
Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.
